verdict.rationale: Any service that holds user data can reasonably be asked about its AI-training data policy, so this axis applies to ANEF, a government digital-administration portal handling personal data. The evidence pack contains only front-door probes showing a JavaScript shell and a Cloudflare challenge. Nothing documents an AI-training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any related data-use policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
